Hi Everyone. I was wondering if anyone had any recommendations for places to backpack or car camp in California. Would be great to get some suggestions. Dont worry about the mileage, I'm just interested in hiking some cool spots.

To kick things off I will recommend Lost Coast with an added side trip to Kings Peak.

San Simeon California State Park, beach camping, wine tasting and culture at the Hearst castle. Muir Woods at Mount Tamalpais State Park. https://www.parks.ca.gov/?page_id=471 The mist rolling in and out through the trees is hauntingly beautiful, stayed a week exploring. One can hike down to Stinson Beach for surfing and dining [hike down and take the bus back up to the camp-ground] then last but not least JEDEDIAH SMITH REDWOODS State Park, a ten minute drive North from camp takes you to Crescent City, walk the expansive beaches, bon-fire and watch the sunset. I found the West Coast to be big dog friendly.

Those are some great spots. I've been to Jade Cove in San Simean, but never got a chance to explore that area too much. Though the entire Big Sur area is amazingly awesome, and I spent 2 weeks over there. I've also been to Muir Woods a few times and it is indeed awesome and has very diverse biomes. I used to pass by Stinson Beach all the time, and agree that its a pretty nice chill area to hang out for a stretch.
Never been to Jedediah Smith Redwoods, but I will definitely read up on it and see if I can gather a few people for a trek.
